issue.title: Retire prettier_enabled
issue.description: Format markdown with prettier when it is installed. SASE_DISABLE_PRETTIER remains a deprecated alias.

task_type_fields.remove_when: No workflow still needs a prettier escape hatch and `SASE_DISABLE_PRETTIER` is no longer exported anywhere.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Markdown formatting skips prettier entirely; the deprecated `SASE_DISABLE_PRETTIER` environment variable is the alias that reaches this branch.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Markdown is formatted with prettier whenever prettier is installed.

payload.entry:
PROVENANCE: this bead replaces sase-nx, the `flag`-issue-type bead that owned `prettier_enabled` from its creation at 2026-08-16T23:32:17Z by bbugyi200.athena.sase-nb.9 until epic sase-pv phase sase-pv.7 (migrate) deleted it on 2026-08-18. Feature flags are no longer their own bead type, so the old bead could not be converted in place -- the bead store's append-only guard makes `issue_type` immutable after `issue_created` -- and it was removed with `sase bead rm` and re-created here through `create_flag_bead`, the path `sase flag new` uses.

CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED: title, size (medium), kind (sunset), and both removal thresholds (2026-11-14 / 0.18.0). No deadline moved as a side effect of the migration.

AUTHORED FOR THE NEW REQUIRED FIELDS: `when_enabled`, `when_disabled`, and `remove_when` were drafted in the epic plan and each was verified against the code before it was written here. `src/sase/feature_flags/registry.py` now points `prettier_enabled` at sase-qf.
